deployment_policy.cohort_rationale: Self-reported prevalent cases are excluded, so the model predicts genuinely incident disease. The ICD-only tier scores higher (mean 0.7295 vs 0.7121) because prevalent cases leak in as positives; the higher figure is the contaminated one.
deployment_policy.risk_output_rationale: Absolute risk is not validated for display. Under the England-train / Scotland+Wales-test split, E/O runs 2-3x for hospital-ascertained conditions due to differential ICD coding depth (Clifton et al. 2026), while registry-ascertained cancers sit near 1.0. Calibration slope is ~1.0 throughout, so rank-based output (deciles, tiers) is supportable; percentages are not until recalibration in D6.3.
